newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran invites Saddam Hussein to Islamic summit.
newsitem.headline: Iran invites Saddam Hussein to Islamic summit.

text.p: An Iranian envoy delivered an invitation to Iraqi President Saddam Hussein to attend an Organisation of Islamic Conference summit Tehran plans to host in December, Iran radio reported on Saturday.

It said Health Minister Ali Ridha Mirandi, who arrived in Baghdad on Thursday, held talks with the Iraqi President on Saturday and relayed an invitation to the summit from Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
Saddam's presence at the summit of the Moslem world's biggest body could concern some Gulf Arab leaders, mainly Kuwait which was occupied by Iraqi troops for seven months in 1990-1991.
Iraq and Iran, regional powers who fought the 1980-88 Iraq-Iran War, are deadlocked over issues that hinder normal ties, including prisoners of war.
